intro.en: A dazzling collision of past and future, where neon towers meet historic lanes.
intro.zh: 霓虹摩天大楼与历史弄堂交相辉映，上海，一座过去与未来碰撞的魔幻之都。

desc.en: A stunning waterfront promenade showcasing a museum of global architecture from the 1920s and 30s, juxtaposed against the futuristic skyline of Lujiazui across the Huangpu River.
desc.zh: 这条迷人的滨江大道宛如一座万国建筑博览馆，汇集了上世纪二三十年代的经典建筑，与黄浦江对岸陆家嘴的 futuristic 天际线形成强烈的时空对话。

highlight.en: Witness the ultimate contrast of colonial-era grandeur and modern Chinese ambition.
highlight.zh: 见证殖民时代的宏伟与现代中国雄心的极致碰撞。

hours.en: Open 24 hours (Best viewed at dusk and night)
hours.zh: 全天开放（黄昏及夜景最佳）

ticket.en: Free (Ferry across the river costs approx. $0.30)
ticket.zh: 免费（乘轮渡过江约 2 元人民币）

tips.en: 1. Arrive by 6:00 AM for a crowd-free sunrise view. 2. Walk south towards the Shanghai Tower for the best photo angles.
tips.zh: 1. 清晨 6 点抵达可避开人潮，独享日出美景。2. 向南漫步至上海中心大厦方向，拍摄角度最佳。

tags.zh: 历史 · 建筑 · 夜生活

desc.en: A classical Chinese garden dating back to the Ming Dynasty, featuring exquisite rockeries, zigzag bridges, and tranquil ponds that offer a serene escape from the bustling city.
desc.zh: 这座始建于明代的古典园林，以精致的太湖石假山、九曲回廊和宁静的池塘著称，在喧嚣的都市中辟出一方静谧天地。

highlight.en: Step into a 400-year-old masterpiece of traditional Chinese landscape design.
highlight.zh: 步入这座拥有 400 年历史的中国传统园林设计杰作。

ticket.en: 40 RMB ($5.50) in peak season; 30 RMB ($4) in off-season
ticket.zh: 旺季 40 元，淡季 30 元

tips.en: 1. Buy tickets online via WeChat to skip the long queues. 2. Explore the adjacent City God Temple bazaar for local snacks.
tips.zh: 1. 建议通过微信提前购票以跳过排队。2. 顺道游览相邻的城隍庙商圈，品尝地道小吃。

tags.zh: 园林 · 历史 · 明代

desc.en: China's tallest building and the world's second-tallest, its twisting, aerodynamic design reduces wind loads while offering breathtaking 360-degree views of the metropolis from its observation deck.
desc.zh: 作为中国第一、世界第二高楼，其螺旋上升的空气动力学设计不仅有效降低了风载荷，更在观光层提供了俯瞰整座城市令人窒息的 360 度全景。

highlight.en: Ride one of the world's fastest elevators to the clouds for an unmatched skyline view.
highlight.zh: 乘坐世界最快的电梯之一直冲云霄，尽享无与伦比的城市天际线。

ticket.en: 180 RMB ($25) for the main observation deck

tips.en: 1. Book tickets online in advance to secure a time slot. 2. Visit on a clear day; the view is lost in the fog during humid summers.
tips.zh: 1. 务必提前在线购票以确保入场时段。2. 请选择晴朗天气前往，夏季潮湿多雾时视野受限。

location.en: 501 Yincheng Middle Road, Pudong New Area
location.zh: 浦东新区银城中路 501 号

tags.zh: 摩天大楼 · 观景 · 现代

desc.en: A striking Buddhist temple with golden roofs that contrasts dramatically with the surrounding modern luxury malls, offering a spiritual oasis in the heart of the city's commercial district.
desc.zh: 这座金碧辉煌的佛教寺庙与周围现代化的奢华商场形成鲜明对比，在繁华的商业中心提供了一处难得的精神绿洲。

highlight.en: Experience the surreal harmony of ancient incense smoke against a backdrop of neon and glass.
highlight.zh: 体验古老香火与霓虹玻璃幕墙交织的超现实和谐之美。

tips.en: 1. Dress modestly and maintain silence in the main halls. 2. Explore the surrounding Jing'an Kerry Centre for high-end dining afterwards.
tips.zh: 1. 着装得体，在大殿内保持安静。2. 游览后可前往周边的静安嘉里中心享受高端餐饮。

location.zh: 静安区南京西路 1686 号

tags.zh: 寺庙 · 佛教 · 建筑

desc.en: A tree-lined avenue boasting the city's most iconic heritage architecture, including the famous Wukang Mansion, blending European charm with Shanghai's unique historical narrative.
desc.zh: 这条梧桐成荫的街道汇集了上海最具标志性的历史保护建筑，包括著名的武康大楼，将欧洲风情与上海独特的历史脉络完美交融。

highlight.en: Stroll through the leafy, historic heart of Shanghai's most romantic and trendy neighborhood.
highlight.zh: 漫步于上海最浪漫、最时髦的街区的林荫历史中心。

ticket.zh: 免费（武康大楼仅限外观）

tips.en: 1. Rent a bicycle to cover more ground comfortably. 2. Stop at the Wukang Mansion intersection for the classic Shanghai photo op.
tips.zh: 1. 租一辆自行车能更舒适地探索更多区域。2. 在武康大楼路口停留，拍摄经典的上海打卡照。

tags.zh: 历史遗产 · 法租界 · 咖啡馆

desc.en: Delicate, translucent dumplings filled with savory pork and a rich, gelatinized broth that bursts into a hot, flavorful soup upon the first bite.
desc.zh: 皮薄如纸、晶莹剔透的汤包，内裹鲜肉与浓郁的高汤冻，轻咬一口，滚烫鲜美的汤汁瞬间在唇齿间迸发。

where.en: Nanxiang Mantou Dian (Yu Garden) or Jia Jia Tang Bao (Huanghe Road)
where.zh: 南翔馒头店（豫园）或佳家汤包（黄河路）

must_try.en: Dip in black vinegar with ginger shreds, bite a small hole to sip the broth first to avoid burning your mouth.
must_try.zh: 蘸取姜丝黑醋，先咬破一个小口吸吮汤汁，以免烫嘴。

desc.en: Pan-fried pork buns with a crispy, golden-brown bottom and a soft, fluffy top, sprinkled with sesame seeds and scallions, offering a perfect textural contrast.
desc.zh: 底部煎至金黄酥脆、顶部松软蓬松的猪肉包，撒上芝麻与葱花，一口咬下，酥脆与软糯在舌尖完美交织。

where.en: Xiao Yang Fry Dumpling (multiple locations) or Dong Tai Po (Shouning Road)
where.zh: 小杨生煎（多家分店）或东泰生煎（寿宁路）

must_try.en: Eat immediately while hot, beware of the scalding soup inside; pair with a bowl of beef curry soup.
must_try.zh: 趁热食用，小心内部滚烫的汤汁；搭配一碗咖喱牛肉汤是绝佳组合。

desc.en: A humble yet profoundly flavorful Shanghai staple, consisting of springy wheat noodles tossed in a fragrant, caramelized scallion oil and soy sauce mixture.
desc.zh: 一道朴实却滋味深长的上海主食，劲道的面条裹满焦香四溢的葱油与特调酱油，简单的食材碰撞出极致的鲜美。

where.en: Maiden (multiple locations) or local hole-in-the-wall spots in Jing'an
where.zh: 弄堂小馄饨（多家分店）或静安区的街边老店

must_try.en: Mix thoroughly before eating, pair with a side of pickled radish or a fried pork chop.
must_try.zh: 吃前务必充分拌匀，搭配一碟萝卜干或炸猪排风味更佳。

desc.en: Melt-in-your-mouth pork belly simmered slowly in a rich, sweet-and-savory sauce of soy sauce, rock sugar, and Shaoxing wine, embodying the essence of Benbang cuisine.
desc.zh: 肥而不腻、入口即化的五花肉，在酱油、冰糖与黄酒的浓油赤酱中慢火煨炖，完美诠释了本帮菜的灵魂。

where.en: Lao Zheng Xing or Lao饭店 (Old Restaurant) on Fuyou Road
where.zh: 老正兴或福佑路上的老饭店

must_try.en: Order with steamed white rice to soak up the rich, sweet sauce; it's a heavy dish, so balance it with a green vegetable.
must_try.zh: 务必搭配白米饭以吸收浓郁鲜甜的酱汁；此菜偏厚重，建议搭配一份清炒时蔬解腻。

desc.en: The traditional residential network of Shanghai, where neighbors share communal spaces, laundry lines crisscross the alleys, and a tight-knit community spirit thrives amidst rapid modernization.
desc.zh: 上海传统的居住网络，邻里间共享公共空间，晾衣竿在弄堂里交错纵横，在飞速现代化的浪潮中，这种紧密相连的社区精神依然生生不息。

significance.en: Represents the communal living, social fabric, and authentic daily rhythm of old Shanghai before the skyline transformed.
significance.zh: 代表了天际线巨变前老上海里弄生活的 communal 居住形态、社会肌理与真实的市井节奏。

best_time.en: Early morning or late afternoon when locals are active in the lanes.
best_time.zh: 清晨或傍晚，此时居民们在弄堂里活动最为频繁。

experience.en: Wander through the remaining lanes in the outskirts of Xintiandi or the Jing'an district, observe daily life, and chat with locals.
experience.zh: 漫步于新天地外围或静安区的残存弄堂，观察市井生活，与老上海人闲话家常。

desc.en: The iconic form-fitting dress that became a symbol of Shanghai's 1920s cosmopolitan elegance, blending traditional Chinese tailoring with Western fashion influences.
desc.zh: 这款标志性的修身长裙，成为了上世纪 20 年代上海国际化优雅的象征，将传统中式剪裁与西方时尚风潮完美融合。

significance.en: Symbolizes the golden age of Shanghai's cosmopolitan culture, female emancipation, and East-meets-West aesthetic in the 1920s-30s.
significance.zh: 象征着上世纪二三十年上海海派文化的黄金时代、女性解放以及东西方美学的交融。

best_time.en: Year-round, but best seen during cultural festivals or at the Shanghai History Museum.
best_time.zh: 全年皆宜，但在文化节庆期间或参观上海历史博物馆时体验最佳。

experience.en: Visit a bespoke tailor in the French Concession to get measured, or explore the Qipao exhibition at the Shanghai History Museum.
experience.zh: 前往法租界的定制裁缝店量体裁衣，或在上海历史博物馆探索旗袍特展。

climate.en: Subtropical monsoon climate with four distinct seasons. Summers (June-August) are hot and humid, while winters (December-February) are damp and chilly. Spring and autumn offer the most pleasant weather.
climate.zh: 亚热带季风气候，四季分明。夏季（6-8月）炎热潮湿，冬季（12-2月）阴冷湿寒。春秋两季气候最为宜人。

days.en: 4 to 5 days to explore the core city, including the Bund, French Concession, and museums. Add 2 days for nearby water towns like Zhujiajiao.
days.zh: 建议安排 4-5 天探索市中心，包括外滩、法租界及各大博物馆。若需前往朱家角等周边水乡，可再增加 2 天。

transit.en: The Shanghai Metro is world-class, extensive, and easy to navigate with English signage. The Maglev train connects Pudong Airport to the city outskirts at 430 km/h. Taxis and ride-hailing (DiDi) are convenient.
transit.zh: 上海地铁世界一流、四通八达，且配有英文标识，极易辨认。磁悬浮列车以 430 公里/小时的速度连接浦东机场与市区。出租车和网约车（滴滴）也十分便捷。

intercity.en: Shanghai is a major hub. Hongqiao Railway Station offers high-speed trains to Beijing (4.5 hrs), Hangzhou (1 hr), and Nanjing (1.5 hrs). Pudong (PVG) and Hongqiao (SHA) airports serve global and domestic flights.
intercity.zh: 上海是重要的交通枢纽。虹桥火车站提供前往北京（4.5小时）、杭州（1小时）和南京（1.5小时）的高铁。浦东（PVG）和虹桥（SHA）机场则覆盖全球及国内航线。

tips.en: Avoid public transport during rush hours (7:30-9:00 AM, 5:30-7:00 PM). Always carry a portable power bank. Download offline maps as some apps may not work perfectly without internet.
tips.zh: 请尽量避开早晚高峰（7:30-9:00，17:30-19:00）乘坐公共交通。随身携带充电宝。建议下载离线地图，以防部分应用在无网络状态下无法正常使用。

practicalGuide.en:
Visa & Entry: Shanghai offers a 144-hour visa-free transit for citizens of 54 countries. For longer stays, apply for a standard tourist visa (L visa) in advance.

Payment: Cash is virtually extinct. Link your foreign credit card (Visa/Mastercard) to Alipay or WeChat Pay before arrival; this is mandatory for almost all transactions.

Connectivity: Buy a local SIM card at the airport or use an eSIM (like Airalo) to bypass the Great Firewall. Free public Wi-Fi is rare and often requires a local phone number to log in.

Language: English is widely spoken in luxury hotels, expat hubs, and major attractions. Download a translation app (like Baidu Translate or Apple Translate) for navigating local markets and taxis.
practicalGuide.zh:
签证与入境：上海对 54 个国家公民提供 144 小时过境免签政策。如需更长停留时间，请提前申请标准旅游签证（L 签）。

支付方式：现金几乎已被淘汰。抵达前请务必将境外信用卡（Visa/Mastercard）绑定至支付宝或微信支付，这是绝大多数交易的必备条件。

网络连接：可在机场购买本地 SIM 卡或使用 eSIM（如 Airalo）以绕过网络限制。免费公共 Wi-Fi 较少，且通常需要本地手机号验证登录。

语言沟通：在豪华酒店、外籍人士聚集区及主要景点，英语普及率较高。建议下载翻译软件（如百度翻译或苹果自带翻译），以便在本地市场和乘坐出租车时沟通。

honestTips.en:
The Crowds are Real: The Bund at night is a visual spectacle, but you will be shoulder-to-shoulder with thousands of tourists. For a magical, crowd-free experience, arrive at 6:00 AM to watch the sunrise over Pudong.

Beware the Tea Scam: Near Yu Garden and Nanjing Road, overly friendly locals may invite you to a 'traditional tea ceremony.' This is a notorious scam that will leave you with a bill of hundreds of dollars. Politely decline and walk away.

Tourist Traps vs. Authentic: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street is a neon-lit commercial jungle that feels more like a generic mall than historic Shanghai. Skip it for the tree-lined streets of the Former French Concession, which offer genuine charm.

Pearl Market Haggling: The AP Plaza (Science and Technology Museum Metro Station) is a maze of fake goods. Vendors will quote you 10x the real price. You must negotiate aggressively (aim for 20-30% of the opening price) or simply walk away.
honestTips.zh:
人潮汹涌是常态：夜晚的外滩固然是一场视觉盛宴，但你将与成千上万的游客摩肩接踵。若想体验魔幻且无人的外滩，请在清晨 6 点抵达，静候浦东的日出。

警惕“茶托”骗局：在豫园和南京路附近，可能会有过分热情的当地人邀请你参加“传统茶道”。这是臭名昭著的骗局，会让你面临数百美元的账单。请礼貌拒绝并径直走开。

tourist 陷阱 vs 真实体验：南京路步行街是一片霓虹闪烁的商业丛林，感觉更像是千篇一律的商场，而非历史悠久的上海。建议跳过这里，前往法租界梧桐成荫的街道，那里才有真正的海派风情。

珍珠市场砍价指南：AP 广场（科技馆地铁站）是一个充斥着仿冒品的迷宫。摊贩的报价通常是实际价格的 10 倍。你必须 aggressive 地砍价（目标为开价的 20%-30%），或者干脆转身离开。

localSecrets.en:
Coffee Capital of the World: Shanghai has more coffee shops than any other city globally. Skip the big chains and explore the boutique cafes hidden in the alleys of Jing'an (like Wuding Road) or Xuhui (Yongkang Road) for world-class roasts.

Hidden Art Havens: Instead of the crowded museums, visit M50 Art District in Putuo. It's a former textile mill turned contemporary art gallery complex, offering a gritty, authentic look at Shanghai's underground art scene.

Local Morning Rituals: To see real Shanghai, visit Fuxing Park or Lu Xun Park at 7:00 AM. You'll witness locals practicing Tai Chi, playing chess, and dancing—a vibrant community ritual untouched by the city's skyscrapers.

Secret Viewpoints: Skip the expensive tickets for the Shanghai Tower. Instead, head to the rooftop bar at the Flair on the 58th floor of the Ritz-Carlton Pudong, or simply grab a coffee at the top of the Bund Finance Center for stunning, unobstructed views of the skyline.
localSecrets.zh:
全球咖啡之都：上海拥有全球数量最多的咖啡馆。跳过大型连锁品牌，深入静安（如武定路）或徐汇（如永康路）的弄堂，探索那些提供世界级烘焙的独立精品咖啡馆。

隐秘艺术避风港：与其去人挤人的热门博物馆，不如前往普陀区的 M50 创意园。这里是由老纺织厂改建的当代艺术画廊群，展现了上海地下艺术圈粗犷而真实的一面。

本地人的晨间仪式：想看真实的上海，请在清晨 7 点前往复兴公园或鲁迅公园。你将目睹本地人打太极、下棋、跳舞——这些充满活力的社区仪式，未被摩天大楼的喧嚣所侵扰。

私藏观景位：省下上海中心大厦昂贵的门票钱。前往浦东丽思卡尔顿 58 楼的 Flair 顶层酒吧，或者干脆在外滩金融中心顶层买杯咖啡，同样能收获令人惊叹、毫无遮挡的天际线全景。
